values.name: Continental
values.description: The equipment is or will be moving across a continent on an intermodal or multimodal basis.

values.name: Export
values.description: Transport equipment to be exported on a marine vessel.

values.name: Import
values.description: Transport equipment to be imported on a marine vessel.

values.name: Remain on board
values.description: Transport equipment arriving on a marine vessel is to remain on board.

values.name: Shifter
values.description: Transport equipment is to be shifted from one stowage location on a marine vessel to another on the same vessel.

values.name: Transhipment
values.description: Transport equipment is to be transferred from one marine vessel to another.

values.name: Shortlanded
values.description: Transport equipment notified to arrive which did not arrive on the means of transport.

values.name: Overlanded
values.description: Transport equipment not notified to arrive but which did arrive on the means of transport.

values.name: Domestic
values.description: Transport equipment is used in domestic service.

values.name: Positioning
values.description: Equipment is being transported for positioning purposes.

values.name: Reloader
values.description: Transport equipment to be discharged and subsequently reloaded on the same means of transport but in a different stowage location.
